scoring_assumptions.experience: min(qualifying installations in the last five years / 10, 1) * 100
scoring_assumptions.price: (lowest price among proposals cleared for ranking / proposal price) * 100
scoring_assumptions.timeline: ((16 - completion weeks) / 16) * 100 for schedules within 16 weeks
scoring_assumptions.warranty: Average of panel warranty score (years / 25) and workmanship warranty score (years / 10), each capped at 100
scoring_assumptions.team_approach: 25 points each for named project lead, identified crew, safety plan, and monitoring plan
scoring_assumptions.note: The assessment provides criterion weights but does not specify detailed scoring formulas. These are proposed design assumptions.
